title: Nasty Liq Blueberry Sour Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid By Nasty Juice
description: Take a flavourful dive into Nasty Liq's Blueberry Sour Raspberry, part of the tantalizing range from Nasty Juice. This e-liquid combines the inherent sweetness of blueberries with the sharp zing of sour raspberries, creating a layered vape experience that tickles the taste buds and leaves a memorable impression. The initial inhale introduces the richness of blueberries, their natural sugars bringing a comforting, fruity embrace that feels both indulgent and homely. But there's an exciting twist—the sourness of raspberries soon follows, providing a lively kick that plays off the blueberries' sweetness. This isn't a fleeting sourness; it lingers, adding complexity to the e-liquid and ensuring each puff is as engaging as the last. The contrasting flavours work in harmony, reminiscent of a wild berry medley that might be found in a summer dessert. This e-liquid stands out with its 50VG/50PG blend, ensuring a balanced vaping experience that's ideal for those who love a good cloud but don't want to compromise on taste. The nic salt formula offers a smoother hit, perfect for vapers using starter kits and pod systems looking for a satisfying nicotine experience with no harshness. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the Nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more delicious Nasty Liq flavours to try. Nasty Juice have fine-tuned their vape juices for optimised performance with the vast majority of MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices. They feature exceptional flavours and flavour blends across fruits, sweets, desserts and tobacco and many are also available in Nasty Juice’s super-convenient Nasty Bar disposable vape bars.
